text: Completed the remaining P3.1 provenance contract. EventPhase now rejects duplicate parent TrialIds as a typed InvalidSchedule. EventModelBuilder materializes one checked EventPhase after subset/drop policies, and MissingValueResolution can retain the exact EventRowProvenance, so missing/modulator policy evidence shares parent, phase, source-row, run, onset, and duration identity with the final term. Rewrote design.multiphase-provenance.v1 as one ordinary DataTable plus one public formula: distinct sample/probe epochs and SPMG1/SPMG2 widths, within-factor centering, missing-value provenance, two-run identities, and overlapping response superposition; no hand-built EventPhase graph or test-side lowering. Added JVM/JS tests for row-permutation invariance, duplicate parents, missing parent columns, negative/out-of-acquisition/inconsistent-run strict errors, and overlap. Evidence: focused suites 48/48 JVM and 48/48 JS; full design 227/227 JVM and 227/227 JS; manifest 29 valid; diff/type-discipline scan clean.
